description: Reviewed historical-instrument applications for GSPL and PEL (review decisions 12 and 16, KEEP_SEPARATE). Each creates ONE delisted historical instrument with its own ISIN and alias, and ONE effective-dated relationship to the surviving security. No alias, no membership transfer, no ratio that is not evidenced. NOT applied by committing this file.
